versions.name: White Bluff Scout Reservation
versions.summary: A primitive Black Warrior Council camp off Highway 43 north of Demopolis, Alabama, the council's second primitive property, available to Scout units most of the year and featuring a large pavilion and a boat landing.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Black Warrior Council's own Facilities page, which lists White Bluff Scout Reservation as its second primitive camp. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (the council gives only a highway, which does not geocode to a point); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
